subject: Simple relation conditions
notes: The unequal-length space extension, observed where it DECIDES the answer rather than merely being available: pb297 T16 compares ALL "ab" with ALL "aba", whose 8.3.3.6.4 GR3 c) lengths are 2 and 3, and the answer is FALSE only because the shorter operand is extended with a SPACE that differs from 'a' at position 3. T10 is the complementary guard - the same space extension must NOT make a one-position slice of a spaces item differ from SPACE.
